## Summary

- audit every warning, error, cancellation, false positive, and false negative in the ten default-branch runs named by issue #1012
- split the timed-out Intel macOS core suite into three filter-aware cargo-nextest slices while retaining a separate specification lane and a 25-minute job limit
- emit budget warnings while commands are still running, build the Box host binary once, and add disabled-by-default sccache backend diagnostics
- remove error-shaped stock-install probing, premature agent-matrix consumers, Gemini/Codex harness warnings, and narrowly scope third-party Node warning policies
- preserve the complete issue/PR evidence, current Rust/JS/Python template trees, Hive Mind guidance, research, timeline, requirements, root causes, and alternatives under `dev/log/issues/1012/pulls/1013/`

## Reproduction and root cause

Run 31871548846 started the Intel macOS core suite at 07:20:17 UTC and was killed at the 35-minute job limit while tests were still passing. Its 2,100-second warning budget equalled the complete job budget and the warning ran only after `cargo test` returned, so the timeout could never emit it. Pipeline Status then correctly failed the cancelled job; Desktop Release correctly skipped.

The green runs also reproduced actionable diagnostic debt: an HTTP 429 and 1,131 Box cache-write failures while seven legs rebuilt one binary, 14 `download-artifact@v8` DEP0005 warnings, VS Code DEP0169, agent-matrix broken pipes, Gemini fallback errors, Codex temporary-home warnings, a misleading stock Rust dependency probe, and a 956-line solver warning.

`dev/log/issues/1012/pulls/1013/local-tests/regression-red.log` records eight minimal invariants failing before implementation. The tenth invariant replays the two real Agent CLI self-authorship sessions byte for byte. The first implementation cycle then exposed a missing web-stage coverage signal for the language-facing solver refactor; the eleventh test now constructs `SolverConfig` for every registered locale.

## Verification

- issue #1012 regressions: 11 passed
- complete CI/CD module: 208 passed
- corrected repository suite: 2,790 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored network benchmarks
- affected issue #988: 4 passed; issue #961: 12 passed; Codex metadata integration: 1 passed
- formatting, supported Clippy targets, example compilation, docs, file-size/language gates, actionlint, and ShellCheck pass
- web suite: 75 passed
- all web-stage gates pass, including explicit coverage for `en`, `ru`, `hi`, `zh`, and `es`
- cargo-nextest 0.9.143 accepts the exact filter and partition command across all 31 selected binaries
- Formal AI plus real Agent CLI authored 2 of 9 smallest requirement leaves (22%), with native sessions and deterministic replays retained
- the definitive remote cycle at `a75bd0cdd03d379d9cdf7dc4cebde99e2f6df7c7` passed all 13 workflows (62 passing checks; 8 intentionally skipped)
- all five exhaustive test jobs remained below 25 minutes: macOS specification 12m09s, three core slices 19m20s/19m31s/18m26s, and Ubuntu 21m29s
- complete final logs were audited: Desktop Release emitted none of DEP0005/DEP0169, broken-pipe/EPIPE, or runtime warnings; optional sccache write degradation remains observable through the disabled-by-default verbose mode and does not affect correctness

Shared template defects were reported with reproductions, workarounds, and suggested fixes:

- https://github.com/link-foundation/rust-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/131
- https://github.com/link-foundation/js-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/133

No visual UI changed, so screenshots do not apply.

Closes #1012
